question.text: A horizontal semi-circular wire of radius $\mathrm{r}$ is connected to a battery through two similar springs $\mathrm{X}$ and $\mathrm{Y}$ to an electric cell, which sends current I through it. A vertically downward uniform magnetic field B is applied on the wire, as shown in the figure. What is the force acting on each spring?

solution.text: $F_B=i \times 2 r \times B$ $2 F=F_B$ $F=i r B$
